How to Play

Pick a level on the island map. Clear the regular levels of a region to reach its guardian. Each guardian you defeat unlocks the next region. Beat all five to open the Hollow Spire.

W A S DMove Left click JMelee attack toward the cursor (hold to keep swinging) Right click KFire your bow (uses arrows) Space ShiftDodge roll, invulnerable while rolling QHealing potion (refills over time) 1–8Use your eight equipped artifacts I TabOpen your pack to equip or salvage loot MEnlarge the level map

Red rings on the ground are incoming attacks. Roll out or through them. Every monster shows a name tag with its role when you get close (Brawler, Archer, Pouncer, Caster, Heavy, or one that explodes). Chests and fallen enemies drop gear: grey is common, blue is rare, gold is unique with two enchantments.
